title: Scientists call for ‘emergency’ measures to save sea life from El Niño | New Scientist
description: Reducing fishing quotas, rescuing endangered species from the water and testing geoengineering could help soften ocean heat impacts from the record El Niño, some oceanographers argue
author: Alec Luhn

title: Why is everyone suddenly worried about the risks of AI? | New Scientist
description: AI experts put the chance of models rising up and killing us all at greater than 10 per cent – but are the risks real? And can anything be done if they are?
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Two bizarre new forms of ice discovered that could exist deep inside planets | New Scientist
description: Crushing water to pressures in the millions of atmospheres has revealed two strange types of ice, which may form deep inside Neptune and Uranus
author: Leah Crane

title: XAI data centre may have led to Mississippi air pollution spike | New Scientist
description: Elon Musk firm’s Colossus 2 data centre – the largest in the US – has been spewing out nitrogen oxide emissions from trailer-mounted gas turbines, an analysis suggests
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Earliest alligator flourished in the wake of the dinosaur extinction | New Scientist
description: Just a few hundred thousand years after an asteroid wiped out most dinosaurs, large alligators were thriving in North America
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: AI is both the best and worst thing to ever happen to mathematics | New Scientist
description: Mathematicians now have a formidable tool for breaking open challenging problems, but working out how best to use it isn't going to be easy
author: Timothy Revell
